title: DoG (local-contrast) detection recovers dim tracked cells

oracle.note: The local eval over the two GT families (44b6_0113de3b clean + 44b6_0b24845f fragmented) reproduces the public LB, so it is a valid promotion oracle.

root_cause.finding: The single tracked cell in 44b6_0b24845f sits at ~p60 of the Gaussian-smoothed volume (raw intensity ~1400-1700 vs frame p99.3 ~2200-2720). A global intensity-percentile threshold never detects it.

screen_global_intensity_threshold.note: Lowering the global intensity threshold does not recover the dim family (frag edge TP stuck at <=5) and degrades the clean family via the node-count penalty. Dead end.

screen_topk_per_frame.note: Top-K-per-frame (K scaled to N_true/n_frames) best micro 0.525 (frag TP <=7). Marginal.

screen_dog_detection_recall_frag.note: DoG response = gaussian(sigma_small) - gaussian(sigma_large); NMS peaks above a percentile of the response. sigma in (z,y,x) voxels.

confirm_dog_full_edge_score.note: Full pipeline (DoG detect + champion linking) scored on both GT families. sigma_small=(1,2,2), sigma_large=(2,6,6), division off, max_distance=7um.
